description_en: Retrieves a single HTTPS application configuration
name: GetHttpsApplicationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869087.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 配置的ConfigId，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869087.html接口获取ConfigId
parameters.name: config_id

AltSvc.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Alt-Svc feature, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
AltSvc.description_zh:
Alt-Svc功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

AltSvcClear.description_en:
Specifies whether to include the `clear` parameter in the Alt-Svc header, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
AltSvcClear.description_zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

AltSvcMa.description_en: The Alt-Svc max-age, in seconds. Default: `86400`
AltSvcMa.description_zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒

AltSvcPersist.description_en:
Specifies whether to include the `persist` parameter in the Alt-Svc header, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
AltSvcPersist.description_zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. You can query for a global or rule configuration based on this parameter. Valid values:

`global`: a global configuration.

`rule`: a rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置

Hsts.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
Hsts.description_zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HstsIncludeSubdomains.description_en:
Specifies whether to include subdomains in the HSTS policy, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
HstsIncludeSubdomains.description_zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HstsMaxAge.description_en: The value of the `max-age` directive for HSTS, in seconds

HstsPreload.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS preload, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
HstsPreload.description_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsForce.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable force HTTPS, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
HttpsForce.description_zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsForceCode.description_en:
The status code for the force HTTPS redirect. Valid values:

`301`

`302`

`307`

`308`
HttpsForceCode.description_zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：

301
302
307
308

HttpsNoSniDeny.description_en:
Specifies whether to deny TLS handshakes that lack an SNI, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
HttpsNoSniDeny.description_zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsSniVerify.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable SNI verification, which is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
HttpsSniVerify.description_zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsSniWhitelist.description_en: The SNI allowlist. Separate multiple values with a space
HttpsSniWhitelist.description_zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔

Rule.description_en:
The conditional expression used to match user requests. This parameter is not required for a global configuration. There are two scenarios:

To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required for a global configuration. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required for a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration versioning enabled, this parameter specifies the applicable site version. The default is version `0`
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
